name: The Myth Funeral
why_it_works: A mock funeral for a bad belief is funny enough to stop the scroll and clear enough to remember. Burying the myth gives the viewer a ritual for letting go of it, and the eulogy format lets you explain why it was wrong without sounding like a lecture.

hook.pattern: Open on a tiny tombstone with the myth carved on it and a solemn 'We are gathered here today...'
examples: We are gathered here to bury "{{myth}}".
Rest in peace, "{{myth}}". You cost people a lot.
Today we say goodbye to a {{industry}} myth.

variables.name: myth
variables.description: The myth being buried, as people say it
variables.example: you need an oil change every 3,000 miles

variables.name: born_when
variables.description: Where or when the myth came from
variables.example: engines and oils from decades ago

variables.name: what_it_cost
variables.example: a lot of oil changes nobody needed

variables.name: truth
variables.example: check your owner's manual; most modern cars go much longer

variables.name: offer
variables.description: What the viewer can do now
variables.example: ask us what your car actually needs, free

beats.voiceover: We are gathered here today to bury "{{myth}}".

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 close-up of a small grey stone tombstone engraved 'R.I.P.' sitting on a workbench at {{brand}}, a single lily beside it, moody side light, tongue-in-cheek solemn

beats.voiceover: It was born in {{born_when}}. It made sense back then.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 vintage-style photo of an old-fashioned {{industry}} scene, sepia tones, film grain, nostalgic, no recognizable brands

beats.voiceover: But it cost all of us {{what_it_cost}}.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 comedic shot of the {{brand}} team standing in a line in work clothes holding tiny paper hats over their hearts, deadpan faces, slow push-in, shop lighting

craft.notes: Play it completely straight: solemn voice, slow pace, one lily. The humor comes from the gap between the ceremony and how small the myth is. Give the myth a fair 'it made sense back then' line so viewers who believed it don't feel stupid.

do_not: Mock customers who believed the myth
Bury a myth that is actually still true for some cases without saying so
Use real funeral imagery that could feel disrespectful, such as a real cemetery or a casket
compliance: Mortgage and insurance: state the truth generally and add 'terms vary by lender/policy'; no rate, approval or savings promises
Chiropractors: no claims to cure or treat conditions beyond your license; avoid outcome guarantees
